title: Genealogy of new members: trombones, trumpets and Swayzee
summary: Looking at the photo, they work out who replaced R.Q. Dickerson, and what became of Swayzee.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Who was next? Who next joined the band? Do you remember?
Let me see. Well, the next thing we started doing is adding on musicians. We started adding instead of getting rid of.
Who did you add?
We added a trombone, another trombone...
Thomas (3) - 29
Who was that trombone? Was that Keg Johnson, or was that... You had Claude Jones there? I don't see... On that picture you got there, Foots, I see DePriest Wheeler and R.Q. on trombones.
Yeah.
Look at that picture of you.
I think there are two (?).
Let's look at that picture again, so we can see if we can get some Cab Calloway history...
Well, I think next...
Look at the picture, Foots.
I'm looking at the picture. I think R.Q. went next.
Who was R.Q.? The trumpet player, right?
The trumpet player, yeah.
Who came in the band in his place?
I don't know whether it was Randolph...
You had Swayzee and them?
Yeah, we had Swayzee. Swayzee may have come in then. Yeah, I think it was Swayzee. Because Swayzee was a good trumpet player.
Was he in before Mouse, do you think?
[PAUSE]
Thomas (3) - 30
We're talking about the Missourians here, and we're trying to get the genealogy of it, and who started or who came later. Now, what happened to Swayzee? Did you say Swayzee died?
Yeah, he had a Confucian doctor, who was giving him some medicine, and it stopped his hearing(?). And that's what killed him.
So he passed away? Now, who did you say was the trumpet player?
Mouse.
What sort of trumpet player was Swayzee?
Swayzee was a good trumpet player.
I mean like what? Give me an example. Did he play like Dizzy, or did he play like Ray Nance, or did he play like Freddy Jenkins, or did he play like...?
Well...
You've got to concentrate. You're thinking of something else now.
No, I'm...
I'll stop this and let you think about that, and then you can go back to it.
